senses.zh_definition: 布伦达：英语命名传统中通常用于女性的名字。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name used in English naming traditions.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang digunakan dalam tradisi penamaan bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 按人名解释，正文写 Brenda。IPA 为英语读法；不应把历史词源中的“剑”或“火炬”当作现代马来语词义。所列搭配为自然教学示例，未核实语料频率。马来语释义为编辑释义，官方词条地位未获确认。[人名及读音来源](https://www.behindthename.com/name/brenda)

etymology.historical_story: Brenda is commonly connected with the Old Norse name Brandr, associated with fire, a torch, or a sword. Walter Scott used Brenda for a central character in The Pirate, giving the name a literary connection. It later became more widespread in English-speaking communities. This history does not make Brenda a Malay word for a weapon. [Source](https://www.behindthename.com/name/brenda)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“布伦达举着火炬”的画面记名字与词源联系；现代用法中 Brenda 指人，不表示“火炬”。
